auditor: separately written recount, independent of run_pw06.py / analyze_pw06.py
method: Separately written recount (no import or reading of analyze_pw06.py, run_pw06.py or pwlib active-unit/convergence code). All MANIFEST hashes and the DESIGN.md freeze verified first. Test-split weights rebuilt from pw01 count_test (code10 uniform); encodings E30/E10a/E10b/code10 re-derived from DESIGN.md. Per run: explicit-loop weighted variance of the stored posterior mean (Burda, >0.01; also 0.001/0.05/0.1; plain AE covariance count); own encoder forward pass vs stored mu/logvar; own decoder(mu) vs stored reconstruction bits; exact/bitwise reconstruction; numerical check; convergence from the logged curve; analytic rate; own 128-draw Monte Carlo distortion (independent RNG, compared within 6 SE). Gates and P1-P3, S1, S2 re-derived from DESIGN.md decision rules, all runs and converged-only.
limitations: Distortion and -ELBO are Monte Carlo and agree only within tolerance (independent draws); same machine and library stack as the run; no independent retraining.
